brief:
A Cairo-based human rights organization, Maat for Peace, Development and Human Rights, has called for an explicit international ban on white phosphorus, citing repeated use of the munition by Israel in Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. The group's demand follows documented deployments of the substance in the territory.

White phosphorus has been used repeatedly in Israeli operations in Gaza, according to rights monitors and international observers tracking weapons use in the conflict.

title: Rights group demands explicit ban on white phosphorus over Gaza use
